name: cc-management-feed
description: Cc の CDGD マネジメント変更列への通知 (support): 保存したコメント・評価を outbox に積み、Cc POST /v1/management/events へ届ける。AI 要約は origin=ai で送り、意見の正本と採否は play-feedback / adoption-decisions が持つ。
cardTemplate: Summarise the "cc-management-feed" domain: stored feedback is queued once per record and delivered to the Cc management feed with the same event key until Cc accepts or refuses it; AI summaries are sent as origin=ai.
